'''Bozzie''' was a willful spirit in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology. "Bozzie" was a popular name for female [[Wokling/Legends|Ewok children]],<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Bozzie|the mother]] of [[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]].<ref name="Ewoks">{{Ewoks|The Cries of the Trees}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Bozzie was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]].<ref name="GCG" />
